title: Multimodal AI: Images, Documents, Audio, and Video
description: Design systems that reason over mixed media while preserving provenance, latency, and safety.
learningOutcomes: Build document and media understanding pipelines
Evaluate outputs across text visual and audio dimensions

lessons.title: Multimodal Inputs and Token Budgets
lessons.description: Understand how resolution, duration, ordering, and detail affect model behavior.

lessons.title: Document Understanding and OCR
lessons.description: Extract structured facts from layouts, scans, charts, and tables.
learningObjectives: Choose native vision versus OCR pipelines

lessons.title: Vision Reasoning and Grounding
lessons.description: Ask answerable visual questions and distinguish observation from inference.
learningObjectives: Require uncertainty when evidence is weak

lessons.title: Audio, Speech, and Video Pipelines
lessons.description: Segment, transcribe, align, and summarize time-based media.

lessons.title: Multimodal Evaluation and Safety
lessons.description: Test extraction, grounding, accessibility, privacy, and harmful-content behavior.
